summary: schema migration: cost_usd + cached_input_tokens on queries; create model_pricing + user_budgets
description:
Migration 006_cost_and_budgets.sql — additive only.

ALTER TABLE queries ADD COLUMN cost_usd NUMERIC(10, 6);
ALTER TABLE queries ADD COLUMN cached_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_pricing (
    model_id                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_price_per_mtok        NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL,
    output_price_per_mtok       NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL,
    cached_input_price_per_mtok NUMERIC(10, 4),
    effective_from              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    effective_to                TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (model_id, effective_from)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_model_pricing_lookup
    ON model_pricing (model_id, effective_from DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_budgets (
    user_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    period       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('daily', 'monthly')),
    query_limit  INTEGER,
    usd_limit    NUMERIC(10, 4),
    queries_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    usd_used     NUMERIC(10, 6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reset_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, period)
);

-- Backfill user_budgets from today's quota_usage rows.  reset_at = next UTC midnight.
INSERT INTO user_budgets (user_id, period, query_limit, queries_used, reset_at)
SELECT user_id, 'daily', 10, queries_used,
       (date + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
FROM quota_usage
WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE
ON CONFLICT (user_id, period) DO NOTHING;

quota_usage stays in place — code will switch over in child 4, drop in a later cleanup PR.

Done when:
- migration runs cleanly under deploy.sh's psql -1 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
- queries has the two new nullable/default columns
- both new tables exist with the correct constraints
- existing user rows in quota_usage are reflected in user_budgets

resolution.note: Migration 006 adds cost_usd + cached_input_tokens to queries, creates model_pricing and user_budgets, backfills user_budgets from today's quota_usage rows with tier-aware limits.
